# BRAINIALL Diarized Transcription API

One external metered endpoint for an explicitly authorized Brazilian Portuguese or Spanish recording.

- OpenAPI 3.1: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fasuizu-br/brainiall-transcription-skill/main/openapi/brainiall-diarized-transcription.openapi.json
- API client import guide: https://github.com/fasuizu-br/brainiall-transcription-skill/blob/main/docs/API_CLIENT_IMPORTS.md
- Safe Postman collection: https://github.com/fasuizu-br/brainiall-transcription-skill/blob/main/postman/BRAINIALL-Diarized-Transcription.postman_collection.json
- Agent Skill: https://github.com/fasuizu-br/brainiall-transcription-skill/tree/main/skills/brainiall-diarized-transcription
- Account and current terms: https://app.brainiall.com/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=llms_txt&utm_campaign=diarized_transcription

Safety: verify recording rights and any required speaker notice or consent before selecting a file. Use a dedicated revocable API key. Confirm price and balance. Send one request only; do not automatically retry an ambiguous metered upload. Human review is required. Speaker labels are anonymous turns, not verified identities.
